utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can take one of those spots—sorting tools sounds manageable for me. Just point me to where I should start.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks, Oren—Cleo said they still need batteries, duct tape, and any spare tools. I’ll keep asking around and let folks know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—I'll look around for any spare tools, and maybe I can bring some duct tape too. Just let me know where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking what we’ve got now and making a list of anything we’re still missing. If anyone has spare batteries, duct tape, or tools, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—thanks for the reminder. I can look around for any spare duct tape or tools and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Noah — I really appreciate that. Let me know what you find, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — I’m ready to help. Just send me the repair list and I’ll see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Leo — we still need someone on the loose railings, the squeaky gate, and a leaky faucet if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll take the loose railings, squeaky gate, and leaky faucet. Send me any tools or parts I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Oren — thank you. Please start at the table by the garage and help sort the tools into labeled bins; I’ll check in shortly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll start at the table by the garage and sort the tools into the labeled bins.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Sam — thank you. I’ll check back soon, and if you finish there, just let me know and I’ll point you to the next task.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still happening, right? I just want to confirm the timing and what’s still left to fix.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, it’s still happening—I'm helping spread the word and line people up with tasks, and we’re keeping track of who’s at which house so Opal can follow up. I can check on the timing details too if you want.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, please—can you confirm the timing details? I just want to make sure I’ve got the schedule right.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly supplies and a few extra hands are still needed—tools, materials, and volunteers to help sort everything. I can keep an ear out for the exact list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. Please let me know the exact list when you have it, and I’ll bring the toolbox and gloves at 9:00.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’ll keep my ear out and let you know as soon as I get the exact list. Toolbox and gloves at 9:00 sounds perfect—thanks, Eli.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s for folks who need help fixing up small things at home—leaky faucets, broken steps, that sort of thing. I heard we’re collecting tools and a little funding for it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds right to me—thanks for explaining, Ira. I’m on the list, so send me the details and I’ll look over what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details and the list of needed tools and donations. Thanks for helping out!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I haven’t checked in yet—sorry. I’m still sorting through some things, but I’ll let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No worries — just let me know when you can. I’m a little fuzzy on the repair drive details anyway, so I’m happy to hear the update.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I haven’t heard any new updates yet, but I’ll check in when I can and tell you what I find.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—I can work around school drop-off, so 10 a.m. at the school lot should be fine. I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye. I’m still trying to get the latest on what the repair drive needs—tools, materials, or extra hands?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can bring my screwdriver set and any spare zip ties I have. If you still need extra hands, I can help after school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up at the repair drive and make sure everyone knows the plan.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that would be a big help. I appreciate you getting the word out at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll make sure everyone hears the update at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll be there at 2 PM. Do you need me to bring any tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mina! If you’ve got any basic tools or spare parts, please bring them along — that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I’ll bring some basic tools and any spare parts I have. See you at 2 PM.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I still need the pickup time and drop-off spot before I can plan around it. Once those are set, I can help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: We’re leaving around 9:00, and I’ll drop us off back at the community shed. I can take the squeaky gate and help with the railings once we get there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, 9:00 and back at the community shed works for me. Just let me know if I need to bring anything for the gate or railings.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly supplies and a few extra hands, I think—tools, materials, and volunteers to help sort everything. If you want, I can keep an ear out for the exact list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help, thanks — but I still need the pickup time and drop-off point before I can commit. Once you have the exact list, please send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll get the pickup time and drop-off point, then send you the exact list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly just a couple loose railings, one squeaky gate, and a leaky faucet if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s still on, and those are the main fixes, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, that’s right — those are the main ones still on the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It sounds like they’ve got a good start, but I haven’t heard the final list yet. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep checking in too, and I can help fill any gaps once the final list comes through.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Jules — that’d be a big help. I’ll let you know the moment I hear what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—10 a.m. in the school lot, and I’ll bring my screwdriver set and any spare zip ties I have.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Hana — I’ll let everyone at the repair drive know it’s 10 a.m. in the school lot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good—see you there, and I’ll bring the tools I mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll be there at 2 PM. Do you need me to bring any tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great if you can bring any basic hand tools or supplies you’ve got. Even a small donation toward the repairs would really help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I can bring some basic hand tools and a small donation. See you at 2 PM.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Still aiming to leave around 9:00, if that works. If you can bring the toolbox and gloves, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, 9:00 works for me. I can bring the toolbox and gloves—anything else I should grab?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn — 10 a.m. in the school lot still works for me, and I can help coordinate around drop-off if needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Faye — 10 a.m. at the school lot it is, and I’ll keep spreading the word. If you can help with drop-off coordination, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll help coordinate drop-off and keep things moving. Just let me know if anything changes before 10.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Oren. Please start at the community hall table and sort the tools into labeled bins; I’ll check in with you once you’re set.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I haven’t checked in yet—sorry. I’m still sorting through some things, but I’ll let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Uli — take your time and just let me know when you’re ready. If anything changes, I can still find you a spot at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—9:00 works for me. I’ll bring the toolbox and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, thanks Eli. See you at 9:00, and I appreciate you bringing the toolbox and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: See you at 9:00, Sam. I’ll have the toolbox and gloves ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I’ll spread the word and see if anyone nearby has extras. Thanks for letting me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Nell — that helps a lot. If you hear back on extras, just send them my way and I’ll match them to the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do—I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I really appreciate it. I’ll send over the details and a quick list of where we could use help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep track of who’s at which house so I can follow up. Send the list when you can, and I’ll stay organized on my end.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Opal — that would be a huge help. I’ll send the list over shortly so you can keep everything straight.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, though I may need a reminder on what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — I just need the quick version again. What are we still missing for it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: We still need a few volunteers to sort tools and help with simple fixes. If you can take one of those spots, that’d be a big help.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
